data.rationale: The commit modifies ri_LockPKTuple in ri_triggers.c to use the scan snapshot's command ID (es_output_cid) instead of the current command ID when locking rows for foreign key validation. This specifically affects the 'fast-path' RI checks where a btree index scan is used to verify the existence of the PK row. To reach this code, the fuzzer needs to generate tables with FOREIGN KEY constraints and execute DML (INSERT/UPDATE) that triggers these checks. The grammar fragment enables the creation of such constraints. The seeds include a specific case where a side-effecting operator class (containing an UPDATE) advances the command counter during the index scan, ensuring that the consistency of the row locking is tested against the fixed command ID logic.
data.grammar_fragment:
new_col : <1.0> @new_col(int) REFERENCES "t1" "(" "c0" ")" ;
alter_table : <1.0> ALTER TABLE @target(plain) ADD FOREIGN KEY "(" @target_col(int) ")" REFERENCES "t1" "(" "c0" ")" ;
